release_notes:
# ANIMIND Studio v0.4.4

## Creation Engine foundation

- Adds a declarative Scene Production Engine for assembling complete Blender scenes from validated component specifications.
- Adds lathed profile meshes, rods between explicit 3D points, and bounded custom vertex/face meshes.
- Adds per-component transforms, bevel and smooth shading controls, and bounded Principled BSDF material settings including emission.
- Adds real Blender AREA, POINT, SPOT and SUN light creation, active camera creation, and approval-gated EEVEE Next / Cycles rendering.
- Connects the new tools to the existing ANIMIND desktop agent and authenticated Blender 4.5 bridge.

## Delivery and reliability

- Includes the Scene Production module in the integrated desktop/add-on package and automatic updater archive.
- Adds a post-update health check for the Scene Production module in the configured Blender add-on folder.
- Updates the in-app publisher to use the matching bundled add-on source when the active add-on is older.
- Keeps release signing on the Windows PC; the private key, passphrase, GitHub publishing token, Blender files, settings and local memory are not uploaded as part of the release.

## Scope note

This is the first scene-assembly foundation, not a claim that every Blender workflow is complete. UV authoring, image texture pipelines, general-purpose retopology, rigging and animation authoring remain future work.
